newsitem.title: USA: Oryx Technology gets major OEM order.
newsitem.headline: Oryx Technology gets major OEM order.

text.p: Oryx Technology Corp said Thursday it received an initial purchase order from a new OEM customer that will result in revenues of $1.5 million in the fourth quarter.
The previous year's fourth-quarter revenues totalled $5.9 million and fiscal year revenues were $26.9 million.
The company said it is negotiating "substantial" additional orders of power conversion products with the same customer during fiscal year 1999.

Oryx, a technology management company, said it expects that revenues generated from sales to this new customer largely will offset the revenue loss incurred by a recent reduction from another large OEM order.
